purpose: Compact current lane index for Phase 2. Historical lanes remain in Git history and indexed execution records, not in the active Agent queue.

lanes.name: Version And Deployment Governance
lanes.riskBoundary: C for source-state records and artifact contracts; A for deployment, promotion, rollback, or production observation
lanes.purpose: Keep source, artifact, deployment, and runtime evidence separate. Issue #457 closed the Vercel boundary; Issue #462 changed Cloudflare native master builds to version upload and awaits one active-deployment proof.
nonGoals: a deployment state machine before deployment evidence exists

lanes.name: Traffic Accounting
lanes.riskBoundary: B for collector contracts, redacted provenance, tests, and protected read-only projection; A for runtime, service, config, quota, or traffic-supply mutation
lanes.purpose: Complete Issue #437. PRs #441, #459, and #460 provide the canonical state, safe provenance, and protected read model; Japan TUIC map verification and SGP TUIC sidecar status producers remain.
nonGoals: runtime config or service mutation in a source PR

lanes.name: Portal User And Resource Lifecycle
lanes.riskBoundary: B for lifecycle mapping, safe DTOs, tests, and focused UI consumption; A for auth activation, schema, or production static replacement
lanes.purpose: Execute Issue #438 after traffic and quota semantics stabilize, without redesigning the Portal or merging payment state into subscription state.
nonGoals: database migration in the first slice

lanes.name: Commercial Foundation
lanes.riskBoundary: B for provider-neutral contracts, event catalogs, disabled adapters, and tests; A for live payment, credentials, webhooks, settlement, or AppsFlyer dispatch
lanes.purpose: Execute Issue #439 only after operational lifecycle contracts are stable while keeping all providers disabled and fail-closed.

lanes.name: Code Boundary Cleanup
lanes.riskBoundary: B for one behavior-preserving extraction with contract tests; A if a refactor changes auth, schema, runtime, or public behavior
lanes.purpose: Use Issue #440 only when Phase 2 work exposes a measured ownership or dependency problem; keep the modular monolith intact.

lanes.name: Production Operations
lanes.riskBoundary: A for every production, provider, DNS, Nginx, systemd, firewall, schema, deployment, promotion, rollback, or live customer-data action
lanes.purpose: Provide serialized read-only inventory, exact approval, validation, rollback, and redacted evidence for production actions without becoming an implementation backlog.
nonGoals: treating a merged PR as production proof
